verdict.rationale: Yubico's first-party material positions the YubiKey as a hardware-backed passkey device. It cites passwordless login, CTAP 2.3 support with 'smoother passkey UX' in firmware 5.8, and FIDO2 user verification via PIN. A community report independently confirms FIDO2/WebAuthn support. Since passkeys are discoverable credentials, this covers the core of the story, but the pack never explicitly describes resident-key storage or the usernameless sign-in flow. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of discoverable/resident credential storage and usernameless sign-in, details on credential slot capacity and management, and hands-on corroboration of usernameless WebAuthn login.
